answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 32906 Country: India Title: My Question is that it is necessary to take wasila of buzurgane Deen while praying to Allah. Question: My Question is that it is necessary to take wasila of buzurgane Deen while praying to Allah. If our prayer is not accepted directly to Allah.If yes than let me know where it is mention. Answer ID: 32906 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1000/836/B=1432) Neither it is necessary to adopt the wasilah (intermediation) of saintly elders in duas nor Almighty Allah needs it. He accepts our duas without wasilah as well. However, it is known by hadith that a dua made with the intermediation of pious elders or good deeds is accepted more quickly. There is a famous hadith in Bukhari named Hadith Zarir in which the holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم) taught a sahabi to make dua through wasilah. It is also proved to supplicate with the wasilah of Hadhrat Abbas (رضى الله عنه). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
